rejected: Low-flow low-gradient outcome papers and VARC-3 endpoint definitions in the app do not describe the natural history of aortic stenosis.
The 2020 ACC/AHA valvular guideline full text is not in PMC.

source.title: A Contemporary Approach to the Management of Asymptomatic Severe Aortic Stenosis
source.whyItFits: Opens with the natural history of severe aortic stenosis and the guideline triggers for valve replacement that are based on that prognosis.
